description: This file defines the ManyToOneHelper class used in Drupal's Views module to assist with handling arguments and filters involving many-to-one relationships. It includes methods for building options forms, adding tables and joins to queries, and managing filter conditions.

classes.name: ManyToOneHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing many-to-one relationship arguments and filters within Drupal Views, including options configuration, table joins, and filter conditions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler property.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines default options for the helper, such as 'reduce_duplicates'.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the options form for the helper, including a checkbox to reduce duplicates.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Returns the field name or formula based on the 'formula' property.

methods.name: addTable
methods.description: Adds a table to the query, following relationship paths and managing aliases.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Retrieves the join object from the handler.

methods.name: summaryJoin
methods.description: Provides the proper join for summary queries, considering options and existing relationships.

methods.name: ensureMyTable
methods.description: Ensures the main table is joined in the query, optimizing join types based on operator and options.

methods.name: placeholder
methods.description: Generates a unique placeholder string for query parameters.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Adds filter conditions to the query based on handler values and options.
